endorsements.quote: We propose a tiered disclosure framework as an initial structure for programs and journals to adapt:
We encourage journals and programs to adapt and adopt such a framework as a condition of responsible practice.

unlisted_practices: Integrate AI literacy into medical curricula as a core clinical competency, including critical appraisal of model outputs, identifying hallucinated citations, and recognizing conditions of model failure.
Professional societies should engage national testing bodies to ensure board certification assessments evolve alongside AI use in training and practice.
Develop oversight policies that keep pace with ambient AI scribe deployment, addressing note length, medicolegal risk, and discoverability of retained audio.
Ensure trainees develop clinical reasoning and human interaction skills through deliberate practice without AI assistance.
Conduct empirical research on disclosure policy, faculty development, learner-use standards, and assessment safeguards in AI medical education across diverse global settings.
Address equity and readiness in AI medical education, including access to AI tools for resource-limited training programs.

screen.reason: An editorial discussing responsible AI adoption and governance in medical education and proposing a disclosure framework.
